review.management_type_reason: RHS: 早春の芽出し前に古い茎葉を約13cmに刈る。stauden.de・種: 秋は切らず春に刈る。おぎはら楽天の「姿が乱れたら株元まで切る」は決まった文なので C にしない。株分けは4〜5年ごと
review.management_type_quote: Cut back old growth in early spring to about 13cm (5in) before growth resumes

[おぎはら/品種] 耐暑性；強

[NC State/種] The specific epithet, arundinacea , is Latin for "reed-like." Prefers full sun, but in hot summer climates, afternoon shade is recommended.
